scope: Whole-fixture scoring labels for scoring-relevant FPL participants only; not a training-ready dataset
source_validation: Reuse published, frozen regression controls and population checks; shared Opta lineage, not an independent provider holdout
missing_values: Never fill missing delta inputs; a primary omitted big-chance-save count is zero only after complete appearance inventory and exact season-total exhaustion
revision_policy: Preserve approved keeper artifacts and old source values. Block entire fixtures with unresolved current-source changes. No goal or own-goal correction is applied.
inactive_rows: Keep full canonical inventory but leave harmonized labels missing on non-scoring-relevant rows; do not invent zero delta inputs
